subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Danske Bank's $230 Billion Scandal
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Danske Bank's $230 Billion Scandal.

hook.text: Between 2007 and 2015, $230 billion in suspicious money flowed through Danske Bank's tiny Estonian branch.

buildup.text: Non-resident clients from Russia and former Soviet states used the branch as a pipeline for illicit funds.

discovery.text: A whistleblower raised alarms repeatedly. Management dismissed the concerns for years.

twist.text: The CEO resigned and Denmark's largest bank became the world's biggest money laundering scandal.

climax.text: Regulators across Europe had jurisdiction but none caught it. The failure was systemic, not individual.

punchline.text: $230 billion. One small branch. Years of warnings ignored.

quiz.question: How much suspicious money flowed through Danske Bank's Estonian branch?
